entities.summary: Pasquale Aleardi (b. 1971-06-01, Schlieren) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Schlieren and Switzerland. Known in the fields of switzerland, composers & musicians, europe.
